توافرت (form VI)
# تَوَافَرْتُ (tawāfartu) /ta.waː.far.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَوَافَرَ (tawāfara)
# تَوَافَرْتَ (tawāfarta) /ta.waː.far.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَوَافَرَ (tawāfara)
# تَوَافَرْتِ (tawāfarti) /ta.waː.far.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَوَافَرَ (tawāfara)
# تَوَافَرَتْ (tawāfarat) /ta.waː.fa.rat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
